## 1. Basic Syntax and Variables
Here is how to print text and define variables. 

```{r}
#.....Printing my first code......#
print("Hello World")
print("Hello World",quote = FALSE)

#======Basic syntax===============#

#.............Variables.......#
# Legal variable names:
myvar <- "John" 
my_var <- "John"
myVar <- "John"
MYVAR <- "John"
myvar2 <- "John"
.myvar <- "John"

# Illegal variable names (Commented out to prevent errors):
# 2myvar <- "John"
# my-var <- "John"
# my var <- "John"
# _my_var <- "John"
# my_v@ar <- "John"
# TRUE <- "John"
